page.title: External Resource Allocation
page.subtitle: Engage outside counsel and consultants, and grant them scoped access to specific cases and contracts. They only ever see what you allocate to them.
page.empty: No external users yet. Invite outside counsel to get started.

invite.title: Hire external counsel
invite.description: Onboard outside counsel and tie them to their firm's due-diligence record. They can only be assigned to matters once their firm's IDD is cleared.
invite.errExistingFirm: Select the firm's due-diligence record, or choose Individual / New firm.
invite.errNewFirm: Enter the law firm name, or choose Individual.
invite.firmHelp: Optional — a counsel can be an individual. If you attach a firm, it goes through Integrity Due Diligence in Compliance; its IDD status is shown wherever the counsel appears, but it never blocks assigning them.
invite.individualNote: Hiring as an individual — no firm and no due diligence on file.
invite.searchFirmsPlaceholder: Search firms with a due-diligence record…
invite.linkHelp: Share this only with the intended recipient. It lets them set their password and sign in to the external portal.

detail.confirmRemovePrompt: Remove this counsel from the org?
detail.noMatters: No matters assigned yet. Litigation/contract users assign this counsel from the case or contract once their IDD is cleared.
detail.iddCleared: IDD cleared — this counsel can now be assigned to cases and contracts from those modules.
detail.iddRejected: IDD was rejected/blacklisted for this counsel. Review the screening in the Compliance module before engaging them.
detail.iddInProgress: Sent for IDD. Awaiting screening & clearance in the Compliance module. You'll be notified when the decision is made.
detail.iddInProgressAssigned: Sent for IDD — assigned to {{name}}. Awaiting screening & clearance in the Compliance module. You'll be notified when the decision is made.
detail.iddSkipped: IDD was marked as not required for this counsel. You can still send them for due diligence.
detail.iddNotDoneYet: This counsel has not been put through Integrity Due Diligence yet. Send them for IDD (assign a compliance officer to screen them) or mark IDD as not required.

request.title: Send for IDD
request.description: Dispatch {{name}} for Integrity Due Diligence and assign a compliance officer to run the screening.
request.errOfficer: Select the compliance officer to run the screening.
request.info: The counsel will appear in the Compliance (Due Diligence) module as a counterparty. The assigned officer is notified to run the World-Check screening; you're notified back once the IDD decision is made.
request.noOfficers: No users can run screening yet. Grant a user the “Run Screening” (screening:execute) permission in the Compliance module first.
request.lawFirmPlaceholder: Leave blank to screen as an individual
request.lawFirmHelp: If this counsel acts for a firm, name it to screen the firm's record instead of an individual one.
request.clearedNote: Once cleared, this counsel becomes assignable to cases and contracts.

allocation.title: Assign external counsel
allocation.description: Grant an external counsel scoped access to "{{resource}}".
allocation.resourceRegionHelp: This matter's region determines which counsel can be assigned.
allocation.selectRegionBeforeCounsel: Select a region to view eligible external counsel.
allocation.noneAvailable: No active external counsel is available in this region. Invite and verify counsel for this region first.
allocation.searchCounsel: Search counsel by name or email...
allocation.iddInfo: Each counsel's IDD status is shown below. Due diligence is recommended but optional; unvetted counsel can still be assigned and will be flagged for compliance.
allocation.iddWarning: This counsel's IDD is not cleared. You can still assign them, but consider having Compliance complete due diligence.
allocation.contribute: Contribute - add hearings, documents and notes
allocation.contractContributeNotice: Contracts are read-only for external users; contribute access applies to Matters only.
allocation.notesPlaceholder: Anything the external counsel should know about this engagement.

directory.title: External Counsel
directory.subtitle: Outside counsel and consultants engaged in your region, and the matters allocated to them.
directory.info: Inviting external counsel and allocating matters is managed by your organization administrator.
directory.empty: No external counsel engaged in your region.

accept.title: Accept External Access
accept.description: You've been invited as external counsel. Set your password to access the matters allocated to you.
accept.invalidDescription: This link does not contain a valid invitation token. Please check the link from your email and try again.
accept.previewError: This invitation may be expired, invalid, or no longer available.
accept.existingDescription: This invitation belongs to an existing external account. No password change is needed.
accept.existingSignInDescription: Sign in with the invited email. Then choose the pending organization and verify the email code.
accept.successDescription: Your external-counsel account for {{organizationName}}{{region}} is ready. Sign in to receive your first-login email code.
accept.passwordError: Password does not meet the requirements
accept.submitError: Something went wrong. The invitation may be expired or invalid.
